# Rob Hough — Design Engineer

> Personal website of Rob Hough (@heymynameisrob). Built with Astro and React, deployed to Netlify.
> https://heymynameisrob.com

## About

I'm a design engineer working at [n8n](https://n8n.io), an open-source project building the future of AI automation. I love designing performant, accessible interfaces that are deeply rooted in craft and quality.

- **Location**: UK
- **Current role**: Design Engineer at [n8n](https://n8n.io)
- **Side project**: Co-founder of [cushion.so](https://cushion.so) — a modern collaboration platform for remote teams

## Work & Demos

Interactive UI demos and experiments:

- [Command K](/posts/command-k-cushion) — ⌘K menu with workspace search, pagination and shortcuts (used in cushion.so)
- [Agent Feedback](/posts/comment-ux-cushion) — Cushion agent status feedback with tool usage and model response streaming
- [Designing Agents](/posts/designing-agent-chat-interfaces) — Prompt and streamdown UI for AI chatbots with markdown parsing and SSE animation
- [n8n Markdown Editor](/posts/n8n-markdown-editor) — Markdown editor with formatting toolbar and streaming preview text

## Projects

- **[cushion.so](https://cushion.so)** — Modern collaboration platform for remote teams. Posts, notifications you control, checkins, and clear decision-making primitives.
- **[Travel](#)** — Gallery of travel photos over the years
- **[Milos](https://github.com/heymynameisrob/milos-zed-theme)** — Tangerine and duck-egg flavoured Zed theme
- **[Agent Config](https://github.com/heymynameisrob/agent-config)** — My setup for agentic coding
- **[pilcrow.xyz](https://pilcrow.xyz)** — Notion-style writing app for lab/working notes
- **[Deal Delivers](/posts/dealdelivers)** — Local directory for lockdown delivery

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: [Astro](https://astro.build) (content collections, SSR)
- **UI**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Animation**: Framer Motion
- **Deployment**: Netlify
- **Content**: MD/MDX with Astro Content Collections
